lessonRef.title: Guided practice: drinking water across the day

objective: I can practice drinking water across the day. I will do one step at a time and check one result.
scenario: The learner selects four checkpoint moments in an ordinary day, keeps a refillable cup or bottle nearby, and at each checkpoint writes one quick thirst note (not thirsty, a little thirsty, or very thirsty) before drinking a cup of water.
materials: learner-local: a cup or reusable water bottle
learner-local: paper and a pencil for notes

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u04-l03-model-card. Watch one complete example.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u04-l03-guided-card. Do the coached move.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u04-l03-independent-card. Choose one complete route. Follow its steps.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u04-l03-evidence-record. Save one result and one reflection.

prompts.text: Describe one checkpoint where drinking water changed how you felt right afterward, such as feeling less foggy, less tired, or more comfortable.

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g3-u04-l03-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g3-u04-l03-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g3-u04-l03-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Checkpoint completion: All four checkpoints included a water break. | Thirst noting: A distinct thirst note is recorded before drinking at each of the four checkpoints. | Connecting signal to response: The learner names one checkpoint where drinking changed how they felt. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g3-u04-l03-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner add a fifth checkpoint on a day with more physical activity than usual and compare that day's thirst notes to the original four-checkpoint day.

resources.title: drinking water across the day coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: The learner selects four checkpoint moments in an ordinary day, keeps a refillable cup or bottle nearby, and at each checkpoint writes one quick thirst note (not thirsty, a little thirsty, or very thirsty) before drinking a cup of water.
Coach direction: Before the day begins, plan out your four checkpoints.
Learner prompt: List the four checkpoints in your day when you will drink water today, such as right after waking up, midday, after being active, and before bed.
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: drinking water across the day complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: At each of the four checkpoints, write a thirst note first, then drink a cup of water.
Response 1 (t2-p1): I drank water at all four checkpoints, not only the ones where I felt very thirsty.
Response 2 (t2-p2): I wrote a thirst note before drinking at every checkpoint, not after.
Response 3 (t2-p3): I used a cup or bottle I could refill instead of guessing at an amount.
Response 4 (t2-p4): I checked whether my thirst note changed between the first checkpoint and the last checkpoint.
Equal-access rule: Use the fictional condition above and complete the same reasoning and evidence without private real-world details.

resources.title: drinking water across the day minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: Describe one checkpoint where drinking water changed how you felt right afterward, such as feeling less foggy, less tired, or more comfortable.

Success checks: Checkpoint completion: All four checkpoints included a water break. | Thirst noting: A distinct thirst note is recorded before drinking at each of the four checkpoints. | Connecting signal to response: The learner names one checkpoint where drinking changed how they felt.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: drinking water across the day supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g3-u04-l03-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g3-u04-l03-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional drinking water across the day condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Checkpoint completion: All four checkpoints included a water break. | Thirst noting: A distinct thirst note is recorded before drinking at each of the four checkpoints. | Connecting signal to response: The learner names one checkpoint where drinking changed how they felt..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g3-u04-l03-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

guardianInvolvement.role: Optional coach only; no guardian attestation is required.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.

account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
